title: Live-sports discovery coverage: why the UI shows ~54 and our collector saw 13
labels: READ-ONLY public-data discovery. No orders, no arming, no execution capability added, and no attempt to evade any geographic or platform restriction.
ANSWER: TWO DIFFERENT VENUES. The UI showing ~54 live events is Polymarket INTERNATIONAL (polymarket.com / gamma-api.polymarket.com), which serves 58 live events. Our collector reads Polymarket US (gateway.polymarket.us), a separate venue with a separate slate, which serves 16. This is not one slate seen twice.

evidence_they_are_different_slates.intl_only_sports: Korean baseball (kor), Portuguese (ptc), Eredivisie (ere), Ukrainian (ukr1), Romanian (rou1), Czech (cze1), Scottish (scop), English Championship (elc), Dota2, MLBB, WTA -- none of which PMUS carries live
evidence_they_are_different_slates.league_catalogue: International serves 469 sports leagues; the PMUS gateway serves 50.
evidence_they_are_different_slates.overlap: thin -- cs2, lol, valorant and sea appear on both

SECONDARY_BUG_FOUND_AND_FIXED.what: /v2/leagues/{slug}/events silently returns only TEN events per league when no ?limit is passed. Our discovery never passed one.
SECONDARY_BUG_FOUND_AND_FIXED.impact_on_LIVE_count: NONE. 16 before and 16 after -- the endpoint sorts live-first, so live events were already inside the first ten of each league. This was a real coverage defect for the PREGAME universe (which is the NFL PRE->LIVE control) and is NOT the explanation for 58 vs 16.
SECONDARY_BUG_FOUND_AND_FIXED.status: FIXED; collector restarted; DISCOVERY_FIX marker written to the stream

liveness_definition_audit.pmus: eventState.live true AND eventState.ended false -- the gateway's own scoreboard field.
liveness_definition_audit.international: event.live true AND closed false, via /events?live=true -- the venue's own scoreboard flag, the same authority the live UI uses.
liveness_definition_audit.rejected_definition: startDate <= now. On International startDate is MARKET-CREATION time, not kickoff; using it returned 601 'live' events including season-long futures (Ballon d'Or, World Series champion). Rejected rather than reported.

POLYMARKET_INTERNATIONAL.selection_rule: <=2 per sportsMarketType family, <=4 per event, cap 150, explicit moneyline-first family priority; never looks at reach
POLYMARKET_INTERNATIONAL.exclusion_reasons: closed or not acceptingOrders; not two-sided (0<bid<ask<1); no clobTokenIds; then the per-family/per-event/total caps
POLYMARKET_INTERNATIONAL.why_measured: this is L5's OWN venue. It is the SOURCE HABITAT reference, measured read-only. We do not and will not execute there.

POLYMARKET_US.selection_rule: <=2 per family, <=6 per live event, LIVE_CAP 200, same explicit family priority; live taken before any pregame
POLYMARKET_US.exclusion_reasons: no slug; not two-sided; then the per-family/per-event caps

venue_tick_size.note: International prices five times finer than PMUS.

first_look_international_live_sports.CAVEAT: 12 sweeps. No reach figure is computable yet -- reach@120s needs 120s of series per state. Recorded to show the instrument works, not as a result. Note this is live SPORTS on International; the 1c/96% reference figure is International BTC15m CRYPTO, a different product on the same venue.

what_is_now_running.pmus: nfl_sunday.py -- 22 live markets across 15 live events at 8s, plus the NFL pregame control (338 market-observations on games <12h out)
